title: Daume-2024-control-10.1038/s41586-024-07309-z
description: Microwire local field potentials (LFP) recorded from Behnke-Fried hybrid depth electrodes in 35 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy during a picture-based Sternberg working-memory task (load 1 or 3). Recordings cover hippocampus, amygdala, dorsal anterior cingulate, pre-SMA and ventromedial prefrontal cortex, and were collected across three institutions within an NIH BRAIN consortium. This iEEG-BIDS representation converts the authors' NWB release from DANDI 000673 without altering signal values, and includes trial, TTL and stimulus-presentation events. The data accompany Daume et al. 2024 (Nature), on control of working memory by phase-amplitude coupling of human hippocampal neurons.
methods_description: LFPs were originally recorded broadband (0.1-8000 Hz) at 32 kHz (Neuralynx) or 30 kHz (Blackrock), spike waveforms were removed by interpolation, then low-pass filtered at 175 Hz and downsampled to 400 Hz. The conversion wrote the source float64 microvolt values to BrainVision float32 without filtering, resampling, re-referencing or channel removal. Events were derived from the NWB trials table, TTL markers and stimulus presentations.
